title: NASA's higher-resolution Mars images released to calm the controversy

tellings.quote: that NASA um released those second higher resolution images to sort of quell the the firestorm that had erupted.

plain: After a public uproar over photos of Cydonia, a region of Mars, NASA, the US space agency, released a second, sharper set of images to calm things down. Tim Alberino, a guest on the show, says this in passing without naming a source. In his telling, the sharper pictures were put out to quiet the firestorm, not just to share new data.
